scope: Scratch-only public AC1032 DWG/DXF pair screening for the PERSUBENTMGR physical-layout investigation
evidence_class: public issue attachment corpus; independent LibreDWG minJSON comparison; local libdxfrw read attempt

provenance.archive_disposition: Scratch-only; no DWG or DXF fixture copied into the repository
provenance.pair_description: Five AC1032 DWGs with AutoCAD 2019 object-enabler DXFs and AutoCAD 2027 MEP DXFs

independent_reader.result: All five source DWGs decode to minJSON, including Platte VPORT_CONTROL/VPORT and PERSUBENTMGR records.
independent_reader.platte_vport_observation: VPORT_CONTROL lists the VPORT record handle 0x57; its separate reactor list contains 0x3d126. The VPORT record named *Active has handle 0x57. Handle 0x3d126 is a separate UNKNOWN_OBJ (type 772) in this output.
independent_reader.platte_persubentmgr_observation: ACDBPERSSUBENTMANAGER class_version 2 is present; LibreDWG reports 64 unknown body bits, so this is not complete independent semantic evidence for its body layout.

libdxfrw_observation.result: All five DWGs abort during TABLES with legacy error 9 while processing VPORTs, before OBJECTS/PERSUBENTMGR are reached.
libdxfrw_observation.platte_trace_excerpt: The control trace reports one table entry, a common-header reactor handle 0x3d126, then logs 0x3d126 as the VPORT record and skips it after parseDwg failure.
libdxfrw_observation.source_route: src/intern/dwgreader.cpp readDwgTables VPORT control loop (approximately lines 8770-8803); parseControl and DRW_ObjControl decoding are in the same translation unit.
libdxfrw_observation.interpretation: The trace and independent JSON suggest the parser may be using the control reactor as a table-entry handle. This is a concrete hypothesis, not yet a confirmed field-layout defect; first establish the exact AC1032 control body and common-header roles against ODA v5.4.1 and the independent decoded record graph.

next_actions: Trace the VPORT_CONTROL common header and body separately; reconcile reactor handles, ordered table-entry handles, NULL/Xdictionary slots and any version-specific phantom handles with ODA v5.4.1 and LibreDWG's decoded object graph.

Add a from-scratch AC1032 control-frame regression where reactor and table-entry handles are distinct, plus truncation, rollback/retry and following-frame checks; keep generated frames as the committed test inputs.

If the field-role defect is confirmed, fix the smallest parser path and rerun the focused selector; then re-read the five scratch-only DWGs and verify that parsing reaches OBJECTS with accurate per-stage error accounting.

Only after read reaches OBJECTS, bind the exact Platte PERSUBENTMGR frame/body span to source bytes and compare candidate field boundaries with the paired DXFs and independent readers. Keep typed semantics/output raw-only until schema and dependency roles are independently resolved.
evidence_ceiling: The archive provides useful public source pairs and an independent-reader screening lead. The current libdxfrw reader has not reached the relevant PERSUBENTMGR objects. No VPORT parser fix, PERSUBENTMGR field schema, graph closure, output support, native behavior or support-claim promotion is established by this receipt.
